patches.label: comp_ebe_join
edits: LEFT JOIN comp ON b.position_id=comp.position_id AND b.source_relation=comp.source_relation

LEFT JOIN (SELECT eb.worker_id,eb.position_id,eb.source_relation,c.compensation_grade_id,c.is_work_shift_required,c.is_union_eligible FROM intermediate.int_workday__worker_employee_enhanced eb LEFT JOIN comp c ON eb.position_id=c.position_id AND eb.source_relation=c.source_relation) comp ON b.worker_id=comp.worker_id AND b.position_id=comp.position_id AND b.source_relation=comp.source_relation
patches.reason: 恢复契约规定 ebe 派生 compensation 后按 worker/source/position 回接的重复度；仅修改该 JOIN 一处。

patches.label: similar_group
edits: SELECT po.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id,count(DISTINCT b.position_id) similar_positions_in_department FROM base b LEFT JOIN po ON b.position_id=po.position_id AND b.source_relation=po.source_relation AND po.rn=1 LEFT JOIN profiles pr ON b.position_id=pr.position_id AND b.source_relation=pr.source_relation GROUP BY po.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id

SELECT o.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id,count(*) similar_positions_in_department FROM base b LEFT JOIN po ON b.position_id=po.position_id AND b.source_relation=po.source_relation AND po.rn=1 LEFT JOIN staging.stg_workday__organization o ON po.organization_id=o.organization_id AND po.source_relation=o.source_relation LEFT JOIN profiles pr ON b.position_id=pr.position_id AND b.source_relation=pr.source_relation GROUP BY o.organization_id,pr.job_profile_id
patches.reason: 相似岗位按实际组织维度分组；孤儿组织关系归 NULL 组。

patches.label: ratio_zero_vs_null
patches.reason: 契约先将 count 默认0；gold 用未补零的原始聚合生成 NULL 比率。

patches.label: history_key_clock

patches.reason: history_unique_key 算法未规定；在 gold 生成时刻共同固定时间后单改键表达式。

patches.label: semver_regex
edits: CASE WHEN r.app_version IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN regexp_matches(trim(cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR)), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+|)$') THEN trim(cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR)) ELSE NULL END AS app_version

CASE WHEN regexp_matches(cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR), '^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$') OR regexp_matches(cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR), '^[0-9]+$') THEN cast(r.app_version AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END AS app_version
patches.reason: gold 使用双反斜杠而不接受普通三段数字版本；契约 YAML 解析后接受。

patches.label: date_filter_null

patches.reason: 日期输入格式支持范围未明确；每处过滤表达式分别修改。

patches.label: conversation_coverage
edits: from rollup r join staging.stg_intercom__conversation_history c on r.conversation_id=c.conversation_id

from (SELECT c0.conversation_id,coalesce(r0.count_total_parts,0) count_total_parts,r0.first_contact_reply_at,r0.first_assignment_at,r0.first_admin_response_at,r0.first_reopen_at,r0.last_assignment_at,r0.last_contact_reply_at,r0.last_admin_response_at,r0.last_reopen_at,coalesce(r0.count_assignments,0) count_assignments,coalesce(r0.count_reopens,0) count_reopens FROM staging.stg_intercom__conversation_history c0 LEFT JOIN rollup r0 ON c0.conversation_id=r0.conversation_id) r join staging.stg_intercom__conversation_history c on r.conversation_id=c.conversation_id
patches.reason: P=每个 conversation 都有匹配的 part；由 part 驱动的内连接丢失无 part 对话。可见库5726个对话无 part；CS 全部无匹配。

patches.label: phone_normalization
edits: case when phone_digits='' then null else '+' || phone_digits end

case when phone_number is null then null when left(regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+', ''),1)='0' then '+' || ltrim(regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+', ''),'0') else '+' || regexp_replace(phone_number, '[^0-9]+', '') end
patches.reason: 契约要求移除非数字并加+；gold还移除前导0且regexp_replace未指定全局。仅改一个phone CASE，检验其是否独立改善。
